craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Refusal hammer; nominal both lines (verbless SA); metaphor-never-definition guillotine close. Rejected: (a) verbs for nominals → killed by SA mirror. (b) softening ruled-out → killed: refusal is total. Read aloud: a-WAIT-ing, de-PEND-ence — NO re-LA-tion FOR the TWO in-ERT-ones … WIN-self-HOOD or-NOT.

lines: Awaiting, dependence — no relation for the two inert ones:
ruled out. Win selfhood or not — metaphor, never definition.
l4.sanskrit_cite: apekṣā pāratantryaṃ ca na saṃbandho jaḍātmanoḥ asaṃbhavādātmalābhe'pyupacāro na lakṣaṇā
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA

reads_against.argmap: Are awaiting or dependence the relation of inert things? → First reduction fails: awaiting-language smuggles in the conscious relatum it should supply.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
